_how_to_use: Copy this file to <ICAO>.json (for example EHLE.json). The file name IS the airport code. Keep only the keys you want to change: anything you leave out uses profiles/defaults.json. Keys starting with _ are comments.
name: Airport name
notes: Free text shown on the Notes card, one line each.
_circuit_agl_ft: Circuit height above the field in feet (AMSL minus field elevation). Crosswind, base and final heights scale with it.
_downwind_call_at: midfield or abeam: where the downwind radio call is prompted.
_runway_sides: Circuit direction per runway end (left or right). Overrides default_side. Your Settings 'side' choice overrides both.

circuit._offset_nm: Distance of the downwind leg from the runway centreline (NM). Downwind is recognised at 75% of this.
circuit._crosswind_along_nm: Upwind-to-crosswind turn starts this far BEYOND the departure end (NM). Optional: defaults to base_along_nm. The turn is called by position, never below the safe turn height.
circuit._base_along_nm: Downwind-to-base turn starts this far before the approach threshold (NM, measured along the runway). Leave out for the generic 45-degrees-behind-the-wing rule.
circuit._final_side_nm: Base-to-final turn starts when you are this far from the extended centreline (NM). Roughly the turn radius. Leave out for 0.35.
circuit._short_final_nm: Short final is called this far from the threshold (NM). Leave out to use 300 ft height instead.
circuit._lead_nm: Turn calls are made this much early so the spoken call finishes in time (about 3 seconds of flying).
circuit._final_trim_nm: Trim-for-final reminder is given once inside this distance.

_papi: papi: does this field have PAPI lights (true/false). glide_deg: the slope (usually 3.0). glide_by_rwy is written by the 'Sync PAPI' buttons. papi_cfg: aim_ft = distance of the PAPI/aim point past the threshold, window_nm = distance at which the PAPI picture starts.

calls._: Optional per-field radio call overrides, same keys as 'calls' in lang/en.json.
